title: wok
text: wok. Arrived today - in pieces.  Disappointed to have to install the handle, without any instructions. I went back to the ad to look and see which side the larger silicone washer goes - I THINK outside the lid... It could ship all constructed??  Geez.  In any case the lid is clear glass and heavy.  The gitchy lid handle is supposed to allow you to stand it up while you work with the pan.  I am not totally in love with the awkwardness of the handle as a result of design for standing.  The pan itself is weighty and has a honeycomb pattern.  The ad says it is safe non-stick.  I have not cooked on it yet and in all honesty I bought it to place my bamboo steamer trays in.  I never hesitate to update my reviews and once I've cooked in on it a few times - if there is something that would add to my review, I will update it.  Although it says you can use metal utensils, I plan to use silicone or wood and I always hand wash these types of pans.  Further, I am NOT afraid to add a little oil to my recipes.  It also should be said that you don't want to put this pan on super high heat.
